integrity.summary: technical_feasibility: needs_correction; 5 critical issues including src/types/ contract_collision between frontend and backend, dangling imports (frontend imports types from backend but doesn't depend_on it), circular type dependency (backend imports from frontend instead of neutral shared types), and missing infrastructure ownership (package.json, tsconfig.json, test configuration not owned by any goal). Proposed corrections: split src/types/ into dedicated bootstrap goal, fix dependency direction (frontend should depend_on backend, not vice versa), add two bootstrap goals for shared types and test infrastructure.

issues.description: Both goal_frontend and goal_backend claim ownership of src/types/ directory - hard build-time conflict on shared type definitions
Goal_integration acceptance spec runs 'bun test tests/integration/ tests/e2e/' but no goal owns the root package.json test script configuration or bun:test setup
Goal_frontend runs 'bun run build' but does not own vite.config.ts or equivalent build configuration that makes this command runnable
Goal_frontend imports types from goal_backend but depends_on goal_extract only, creating a dangling import
Circular type dependency: backend imports types from frontend, but types should flow from backend (data producer) to frontend (data consumer)
Goal_extract's essential spec (acc-extract-artifacts) uses only file existence checks - passes by construction when goal completes
Goal_integration's acceptance spec runs 'bun test tests/integration/ tests/e2e/' but test infrastructure is not owned by any goal, making this command depend on external state
Goal_backend depends_on goal_frontend but should be independent - data producer should not depend on data consumer

corrections.reason: Fix ownership overlap on src/types/ - frontend should not own shared types
Fix ownership overlap on src/types/ - backend should not own shared types, and remove circular dependency
Remove circular dependency - frontend should depend on backend for data contract, not vice versa
Backend as data producer should depend only on extraction/bootstrap, not on frontend consumer

missingGoals.title: Setup shared TypeScript types and project infrastructure
missingGoals.objective: Create shared type definitions (Stock, OHLC, TechnicalIndicators, StockInfo) in src/types/index.ts that both frontend and backend can import. Also initialize root package.json with Bun configuration, devDependencies for Vite/React/Tailwind, test scripts, and tsconfig.json for the project.
missingGoals.reason: Shared types must be owned by a neutral bootstrap goal, not by either consumer. Build infrastructure (package.json, tsconfig.json) must be owned to make 'bun run build' and 'bun test' commands runnable.

missingGoals.title: Setup test infrastructure and configuration
missingGoals.objective: Create bun:test configuration and test directory structure with proper setup for integration and E2E testing. Include test utilities, mocks, and the tests/ directory organization.
missingGoals.reason: The integration goal needs test infrastructure to be owned somewhere. bun:test configuration and test utilities should be centralized.
